timebase.membership: integer comparison only; no float epsilon

topology_table.topology: intact then slip re-entry at ceiling

t_ext.confirmation: 3 seeds at newly located flips and F=3.0 censoring endpoint when it supports closure

judgment.damage_rule: latched fraction of tets whose temporal-max principal Green strain exceeds eps_damage
judgment.precedence: damage > slip only when damage_latch_t < drop_t

validity_gate.evidence: device-side per-solver-substep accumulation against actual contacted soft feature
validity_gate.host_download: end of frame and every 20 substeps during transport

graded_fail_closed_policy.isolated_interior_first_failure: invalidate and censor cell; certified=false; exclude from boundary, T-EXT, closure, classifier; continue row
graded_fail_closed_policy.uncertified_evidence: never supports boundary, T-EXT trigger, or closure

rules.INCONCLUSIVE: any deciding row contains uncertified or unconfirmed cells
rules.P-B CLOSURE: empty band at a confirmed closure coordinate; a* only when empty for all tested a at and above a_c
rules.P-A CONTRACTION: no closure; F_lo non-decreasing; endpoint increase >=0.2 N; endpoints confirmed
rules.P-C NO EFFECT: no closure and identical label vector across all tested a

prediction.calibration_note: Intercept fitted to frozen slip 0.6 / intact 0.8 bracket: F(0)=0.70 N and mu_eff=0.628/1.40=0.449; acceleration dependence is out of sample; no post-hoc refit.
prediction.scoring: observed edge=(F_last_slip,F_first_intact]; hit iff prediction bracket intersects; censored unscored

F_star_intersection_rule: INT(E)=intersection across compared a of confirmed certified intact F values
if nonempty choose median, ties lower
require margin F* >= F_lo(E,a_max)+0.2; otherwise smallest satisfying, else max with margin_met=false
if empty use maximal contiguous a-subset starting at a=1 with nonempty intersection
fewer than two surviving a levels skips material fail-closed

falsifier.statistic: R=peak(tangential/normal resultant) over transport, one value per seed
falsifier.supported: three-seed [min,max] at a_max strictly disjoint from and greater than a_min range
falsifier.sample_exclusion: per-pad normal <0.05 N or pad out of contact

w3_scene_rules.scene_A: E15 then E25 then E7 at F*, a=1, intact certified; fallback any confirmed certified intact, lowest a then F closest to F*; otherwise unavailable
w3_scene_rules.scene_B: same E and F as Scene A (hard same-grip), highest certified slip a
w3_scene_rules.scene_C: lowest-a certified damage cell at highest F primary or extension; otherwise unavailable

reduction_ladder.projected_finish_formula: now + median cell runtime*remaining approved N_target + mandatory confirms + T-EXT worst case + 6.0 h W2/W3/W4 reserve
reduction_ladder.LT-1: 2026-08-29 09:00 KST: if PF > freeze-2h, propose dropping a=2.5 (N_target 126->105)
reduction_ladder.LT-2: 2026-08-29 21:00 KST: if PF > freeze-2h, propose dropping remaining E=15 kPa

acceptance_criteria: Pre-registration committed before production; every receipt has prereg_sha256, git_sha, newton_commit, passing frozen_check
G0-prime passes three anchors x three seeds against committed pre-edit baseline with required equivalence metrics and media
G-TRK passes 5% at every plateau/a and noise floor, sample, structural and membership gates
Every receipt contains commanded, tracking, force, slip, strain, damage/drop, all-substep VG, certification, health, grid, label and strain-field evidence
Every primary/damage/T-EXT boundary and closure-supporting F=3 endpoint is three-seed unanimous with hashed manifest
All material band files validate e1v2_band.v1 and labels reproduce from strain fields
Phase diagram reports grids, realized acceleration, classifier and prediction scoring
T-EXT closes by confirmed boundary/endpoint or reports unresolved without extrapolation
W2 ATTR and availability recorded; raw series/NPZ reproduce bitwise; overlays, equilibrium and falsifier reported
W3 manifest proves source/config/hash/reproduced label and same-grip; unavailable scenes documented; no substitution
Gate media for G0-prime, every G-TRK a, and ATTR are hashed
W4 results, handoff, decisions and complete hashed manifest include unresolved work
Frozen allowlist passes against model state and every receipt; rig diff limited to authorized changes; no MPM run

spec_amendments.change: G0'-prime damage-branch DVF criterion: PASS iff label-equivalence across 0.5% threshold AND (extended per-seed DVF within baseline seed range widened by 20% of range OR |delta|<=0.01 absolute), whichever looser.
spec_amendments.rationale: The +-20% per-seed DVF tolerance is tighter than the damage branch's intrinsic ~60% relative seed spread; the failing seed's value lies inside the baseline seed range and every robust metric (label/slip/P99/COM-z RMS) passes.

spec_amendments.change: Realized-acceleration axis: commanded levels are exposure levels; scientific axis uses per-level realized medians. G-TRK redefined as a repeatability gate (per-level realized plateau accel monotone + well-separated + CV<=5% across cells/materials/grasp-states; keep r^2 bound + zero-command noise floor<=0.01; any level failing -> STOP). FF (D3-C) disabled but retained.
spec_amendments.rationale: D3-C feed-forward is clamped by the j_x position PD -> ineffective at any mass (free-carriage receipt reports/vbd/g_trk_gate.md). Frozen gains untouched; profile pre-scaling rejected.
spec_amendments.t_ext_unchanged: top realized level keeps predicted slip boundary (~1.5 N) inside the frozen force grid

spec_amendments.change: Transport slip label = |residual world-x block-COM-vs-gripper displacement at settle-end| > 2mm OR drop/eject. max-3D peak + Y/Z residual demoted to recorded non-labeling observables.
spec_amendments.rationale: max-3D metric is non-reproducible (7.60/5.30/1.81mm same cell) and captures transient wobble + Y/Z re-seating, not grip failure (x_settle~0). See reports/vbd/slip_metric_issue.md.
spec_amendments.gpu_nondeterminism: transport trials are NOT deterministic; 3-seed + two-thirds band rules mandatory; T-EXT on confirmed labels only
spec_amendments.acceptance_test: a=1 row monotone in F + intact at 0.8-1.5N (realized ~0.65) before screen resumes
